text:
samir: heads-up — final cutoff for v1.12 in ~3h (today 18:00 UTC). please avoid non-essential merges. will publish freeze notes in the handbook page in 10m :clock3:

olivia: are docs-only bumps allowed after cutoff? quick question — changelog-only edits?

samir: docs-only is allowed but prefer push-before-cutoff if possible. if after cutoff, mark as docs-only and include changelog entry and a reviewer from docs. tag me for a quick OK.

jen: ping — i have a small runtime-config fix that slipped through CI flakes. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pull/6842 — it's unit-only, no model changes. tests green locally. can i request late-merge exception?

andre: @jen can you paste the runbook / rollback plan? also do we need a canary?

jen: rollback plan: revert PR (one-liner). no schema or migration changes. canary: optional but would prefer quick canary on staging for 30m.

samir: ok share CI link and add a changelog note (docs-only if applicable). if CI passes and @andre signs off on the canary, i'll approve exception. we want the minimal blast radius.

jen: CI: https://ci.internal/builds/87921 — all checks passed. changelog: added under "runtime". updated PR description with /*changelog: runtime: fix env parsing*/

release-bot: Reminder: release cutoff for v1.12 in 2h 45m. See /releases/v1.12/cutoff for details.

andre: glanced at the PR. OK for staging canary 30m. please run a scoped smoke job (kv cache + long convo) and post results. :white_check_mark:

jen: starting canary now — will post smoke log snippets. command: ```./scripts/run-smoke --profile=canary --suite=kv,long-convo --duration=15m```

ci-bot: Canary job triggered: build=87921-canary. smoke-suite: running.

jen: smoke passed (no regressions in kv/cache or latency below SLO). samples look good. posted logs to the PR.

samir: approved. Condition: merge only after you add explicit changelog entry and mark the PR with `cutoff-exception: approved-by-samir`. keep deployment window quiet for 30m after merge.

jen: done — added changelog file and applied label. merging in 2m. thanks all. :pray:

ci-bot: Merge succeeded: PR #6842 merged into release/v1.12 by jen at 1742500285. Build pipeline triggered for release branch.

samir: noted — monitoring for 30m. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
